[P2] Establish regression coverage for live empty-error normalization

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” is unmet here. The callback-completion regressions supply nonempty errors; the empty-payload regressions construct history or operation objects directly. Reverting this expression to `error=error` therefore leaves those assertions unchanged, allowing the in-memory/filesystem discrepancy to return undetected. Please return to the design phase under rule 8 and establish a regression covering an actual callback completion without diagnostics across the state/history boundary before revising the implementation.
